title: Brief Music in Mood Regulation (BMMR)
description: The following statements describe different ways people use music to manage their feelings and moods. Please indicate how much you agree or disagree with each statement.

questions.text: I usually put background music on to make the atmosphere more pleasant.
I like to use music to bring to mind good experiences from the past.
I use music to help boost my own confidence.
I use music to create the right mood for social occasions.
Music is important to me as a means of self-expression.
I often have music playing in the background even when I am doing other things.
I use music to feel connected with people who are important to me.
I often listen to music to escape from things that are bothering me.
I use music to help me to relax.
For me, music is a way to forget about my worries.
When stressful thoughts keep going around in my head, I start to listen to music to get them off my mind.
When I feel bad, I try to get myself in a better mood by engaging in some nice music-related activity.
When I'm really angry, I feel like listening to some angry music.
When everything feels bad, it helps me to listen to music that expresses my bad feelings.
When I'm angry with someone, I listen to music that expresses my anger.
Music helps me to understand different feelings in myself.
I use music to work through difficult feelings.
I use music to help me understand how I am feeling.
I use music to explore my feelings.
Listening to music helps me to find answers to problems.
I use music to search for meaning in life.
